What the salon does

Colour and balayage

Highlights, dye and balayage, often in blonde. Balayage is the most frequent keyword in the Google reviews.

Cuts

A salon on Pafou street

Exclusivo Hair Salon is on Pafou street in Limassol, open five days a week, with 3.400 followers on Facebook. The year 2008 stands in the salon’s logo, next to a pair of scissors. Its own photos show blonde waves and layers, and a bright room with black chairs and a blue sofa. There is no website of its own: the Google listing has no website entry.
